min_runs.source: mstack starting value: the fewest counted runs for which a median and a middle-half spread say anything. Not taken from a standard.
min_runs.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number

relative_floor_pct.source: mstack starting value: a difference smaller than this is treated as noise even when both spreads are tiny. Not measured on any machine.
relative_floor_pct.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number

max_spread_pct.source: mstack starting value: above this the middle half of the runs is so wide that the script declines to compare. Not taken from a standard.
max_spread_pct.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number
